headline: Presidential order creates a Council of Governors to work with federal officials.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a group called the Council of Governors. Based on the title alone, it creates a formal body made up of state governors to meet and advise federal officials. No summary was provided, so details about its exact duties, size, and membership are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Some governors would serve on the new council and take part in its discussions with federal officials.
Federal officials would have a formal group of governors to consult with.

when_it_takes_effect: 2010-01-11 (date signed; executive orders usually take effect when signed)
